infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FarmBridge uses your location to show local weather and market prices.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FarmBridge uses the camera to diagnose crop health issues.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FarmBridge uses your photos for profile and community posts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: FarmBridge shares your position with the customer whose load you are carrying, so they can see the delivery coming. This only happens during a trip you have accepted, and only that one customer sees it.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: FarmBridge uses your location to name where you are, show local weather, and find transporters near you.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: FarmBridge shares your position with the customer whose load you are carrying, so they can see the delivery coming. This only happens during a trip you have accepted, and only that one customer sees it.

plugins.photosPermission: FarmBridge uses your photos for your profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: FarmBridge uses your camera for your profile picture.
